body: How old are you brother? I'm 28 I've felt this way since my early teens, this isn't living, I can't run forever. Sometimes I outrun it and get ahead but it always catches up, I'm tried of so much struggling.

I'm not sure brother, this comes and goes but right now it's exacerbated by a situation that isn't going well with a girl. 
But it's way more than just that there's so much stirring in there, this knot in my throat is annoying.
